definitions.explanation: Seating area for spectators at sports events, concerts, theaters, and other performances.

examples.japanese: {観客席|かんきゃくせき}は{満員|まんいん}だった。
{選手|せんしゅ}は{観客席|かんきゃくせき}に{向|む}かって{手|て}を{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: The athlete waved to the spectator stands.

examples.japanese: {観客席|かんきゃくせき}から{大|おお}きな{歓声|かんせい}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: A great cheer rose from the stands.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {観客|かんきゃく} (spectator, audience) + {席|せき} (seat).

SYNONYMS/RELATED:
- スタンド: stands (English loanword, common for sports)
- {客席|きゃくせき}: audience seats (more for theaters)
- {観覧席|かんらんせき}: viewing seats (formal)

TYPES OF SEATING:
- {指定席|していせき}: reserved seating
- {自由席|じゆうせき}: unreserved seating
- {立|た}ち{見|み}{席|せき}: standing area
- バックスタンド: back stand
- メインスタンド: main stand

CONTEXTS:
- スポーツ{観戦|かんせん}: watching sports
- コンサート: concerts
- {演劇|えんげき}: theater
- {映画館|えいがかん}: movie theaters (though {客席|きゃくせき} more common)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {観客席|かんきゃくせき}が{埋|う}まる (the stands fill up)
- {観客席|かんきゃくせき}から{声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}る (to cheer from the stands)
